facts.text: The hotel is located on Tel Aviv's Mediterranean Sea boardwalk.
facts.excerpt: located on the city’s bustling Mediterranean Sea boardwalk

facts.text: The Dan Tel Aviv was the first luxury hotel to be built in Tel Aviv.
facts.excerpt: We were the first luxury hotel to be built in Tel Aviv

facts.text: The Dan Tel Aviv is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: the Dan Tel Aviv (99 HaYarkon Street), the city's first luxury hotel and a member of The Leading Hotels of the World

facts.text: The hotel is known for its colorful facade.
facts.excerpt: A landmark of the city with its colorful facade

facts.text: The hotel's design is contemporary with a classic elegant twist.
facts.excerpt: Contemporary design with a classic elegant twist and an urbanic chic atmosphere

facts.text: Guestrooms and suites face either the sea or the city.
facts.excerpt: We offer sea-facing or city view guestrooms and suites

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool with sea water and an indoor heated swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: An outdoor pool with sea water and an indoor heated swimming pool

facts.text: The hotel says it is the only hotel with two pools overlooking the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: The only hotel with 2 pools overlooking the Mediterranean

facts.text: The hotel has a fully equipped gym and a dry sauna.
facts.excerpt: Fully equipped gym and dry sauna

facts.text: Cafe 99 serves breakfast and brunch.
facts.excerpt: Cafe 99 serves the city's best breakfast and brunch

facts.text: On Tuesday nights, Timeless Tuesday offers a special menu and live DJ music.
facts.excerpt: Timeless Tuesday - Tuesday nights with a special menu and live DJ music

facts.text: Heading north on the promenade leads to the Old Tel Aviv Port.
facts.excerpt: Head north on the promenade, and you will discover the Old Tel Aviv Port

facts.text: Heading south on the promenade leads to the ancient port city of Jaffa.
facts.excerpt: Head south, and you will arrive at the ancient port city of Jaffa

facts.text: The hotel is near the city's nightclubs and bars.
facts.excerpt: The Tel Aviv hotel is conveniently located near the city’s hottest nightclubs and bars

facts.text: The hotel has hosted international VIPs including Paul McCartney, Madonna and The Rolling Stones.
facts.excerpt: It is the hotel of choice for visiting international VIPs, including Bill and Hilary Clinton, Paul McCartney, Madonna, The Rolling Stones, U2, and Lady Gaga.

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the sea and the beaches.
facts.excerpt: The Dan Tel Aviv Hotel overlooks the sea and the magnificent beaches.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed, though guide dogs and service dogs are.
facts.excerpt: Pets are welcome: No

facts.text: The hotel's parking is operated by an external company.
facts.excerpt: Operated by an external company

facts.text: The hotel is at 99 HaYarkon Street.
facts.excerpt: 99 HaYarkon St'

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel has an excellent spa; the official page lists only a gym and dry sauna.
facts.excerpt: This stylish 280-room seafront hotel has an excellent spa.
